| Source | Building Area (SF) |
|---|---|
| Rent Roll (XLSX) | 128,400 |
| CSV export #1 | 133,750 |
| CSV export #2 (listed as "Kestrel Point Logistics Ctr") | 118,300 |
| Comparable Set Extract (PDF) | 121,900 |

**Answer:** The four sources give conflicting building area figures for Kestrel Point Logistics Center, ranging from 118,300 SF to 133,750 SF — a spread of over 15,000 SF (roughly 13%). No two sources match exactly:
- Rent Roll: 128,400 SF
- CSV file (one record): 133,750 SF
- CSV file (another record, abbreviated name "Kestrel Point Logistics Ctr"): 118,300 SF
- PDF Comparable Set Extract: 121,900 SF

So the sources do **not** agree — there is a discrepancy across all four, and this inconsistency should be flagged/reconciled before relying on any single figure for underwriting or valuation purposes.
